note: This is the ONLY quantitative shape the current codebase can evaluate: {rule_id: single_float_value}. rule_id must already exist as a row in rule_atoms (i.e. already extracted from a real ingested circular via classifier.py's regex templates). There is no field here for period, borrower, currency, or bucket - see ANALYSIS.md for why the richer formats above (CRILC, ALM/SSL, Form A memo) cannot be fed into this dict as-is without new schema + a mapping layer.
